subject.title: [codex] Fix Anthropic Vertex npm audit regression

question: Should Anthropic Vertex stay on current main's upgraded official @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk path, or should maintainers sponsor this PR's local BaseAnthropic/GoogleAuth replacement after a full refresh?
rationale: The central audit/auth dependency issue is mostly addressed on current main, but the PR has protected labels and changes an auth-provider implementation boundary that automation should not choose unilaterally.

options.title: Keep Official SDK Path
options.body: Treat current main's @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk 0.19.0 provider graph as the canonical direction and close or replace this stale local-client branch after confirming the linked issue is resolved.

options.title: Sponsor Local Client Refresh
options.body: Ask for a rebased PR that keeps the local client but fixes dependency ownership, provider shrinkwrap, cache-control behavior, and live Vertex proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow To Dependency Repair
options.body: Replace the branch with a smaller provider dependency/shrinkwrap repair if maintainers do not want to own a local Vertex client implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep Official SDK Path
recommendation.body: Treat current main's @anthropic-ai/vertex-sdk 0.19.0 provider graph as the canonical direction and close or replace this stale local-client branch after confirming the linked issue is resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the candidate branch and is the explicit project owner listed in repository contributor routing, so the local-client versus official-SDK direction should route to him first.
